subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should this PR establish the grouped one-Claw/one-new-agent schema as the implementation foundation before the Claws RFC is accepted, and should v1 include an immutable install identity distinct from the agent id?
rationale: Code review can assess the fail-closed implementation, but it cannot decide whether these manifest, identity, provenance, and lifecycle contracts should become OpenClaw product surfaces while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve after RFC acceptance
options.body: Accept the grouped model and decide the install-identity contract in the RFC, then merge this base after the stale fixture and proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the v1 contract
options.body: Reduce the initial schema or defer identity-sensitive fields until the lifecycle owner model is settled, then update this branch and downstream stack.

options.title: Land as experimental now
options.body: Merge the process-gated base while explicitly accepting that downstream work may require breaking the experimental schemas and plan output.

recommendation.title: Approve after RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped model and decide the install-identity contract in the RFC, then merge this base after the stale fixture and proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the most comprehensive visible product/schema review and are the clearest routing candidate for the remaining contract decision.
